items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Well, the only thing -- there seemed to be a separate tradition, because, I mean, there was Joe Turner and Pete Johnson there, and there was that good old Julia Lee.

ctx.x: There is something about that style of music that's distinctive. And I can't put it in words, though, I don't know what it was.
Well, the only thing -- there seemed to be a separate tradition, because, I mean, there was Joe Turner and Pete Johnson there, and there was that good old Julia Lee.
